entities.name: Jason's Keys Apartment
entities.description: Jason lives rent-free at one of Brian Heder's properties in the Keys. The likely starting safehouse.

entities.name: Vice City Motel Room
entities.description: Trailer 2's neon motel scenes point to a cheap early hideout in the city. Consensus pick, not confirmed.

entities.name: Shared City Apartment
entities.description: The Extended Look showed safehouse daily life: fridges, routines, Jason & Lucia living together. Exact spot TBC.

entities.name: Port Gellhorn Room
entities.description: A faded-resort-town bolthole for the northern arc. Pure prediction, marked honestly.

entities.name: Jack of Hearts
entities.description: Boobie Ike's strip club, straight from Rockstar's character pages and the Extended Look's dollar-bill rain.

entities.name: Only Raw Records
entities.description: Dre'Quan Priest's label, backed by Boobie's studio money. Real Dimez are the first big signing.

entities.name: Tisha-Wocka Flea Market
entities.description: Bootleg brands and open-air hustle, name-dropped in Rockstar's own Vice City description.

entities.name: Little Cuba Panadería
entities.description: Rockstar calls out the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba. Exact storefront TBC at launch.

entities.name: Uncle Jack's Liquor
entities.description: Liquor store visible in Trailer 1's Port Gellhorn getaway shot.

entities.name: Port Gellhorn Pawn & Gun
entities.description: Pawn shop signage caught in Trailer 1. Pawn, guns, and questionable decisions under one roof.

entities.name: Heder's Boat Yard
entities.description: Brian Heder, a golden-age smuggler, runs a boat yard in the Keys with Lori. Jason's employer.

entities.name: Fence (Stolen Goods)
entities.description: The Extended Look confirmed fences buy your stolen valuables. First city fence, exact shop TBC.

entities.name: Gas Station (Robbable)
entities.description: Gas station robberies are confirmed, so pick speed or profit. Rural stops like this one are prime targets.

entities.name: Waffle Diner (Robbable)
entities.description: The Extended Look showed a waffle-restaurant stickup. Name of the chain still unconfirmed.

entities.name: Wyman's World Auto Salvage Co.
entities.description: Wyman's salvage business, an Ultimate Edition perk. Map position is our guess until launch.

entities.name: Gun Store
entities.description: A Leonida gun chain is a series lock, but no storefront has been officially shown. Placeholder pin.

entities.name: Prologue (Keys Start)
entities.description: Press consensus: the story opens around Jason's life in the Keys. Structure marker until launch.

entities.name: Runs for Brian Heder
entities.description: Jason works for local drug runners, and Heder's smuggling jobs are all but certain early missions.

entities.name: Raul Bautista's Crew
entities.description: A seasoned bank robber always hunting for talent, in Rockstar's words. Expect heist work.

entities.name: Only Raw Hustle
entities.description: A music-scene story thread through Dre'Quan and Real Dimez feels inevitable. Unconfirmed.

entities.name: Cal's Signal Watch
entities.description: Cal Hampton monitors Coast Guard chatter from home. Surveillance-flavored jobs predicted.

entities.name: Gellhorn Turf (Expected)
entities.description: A story arc in the faded panhandle resort town is widely expected. Marker for structure only.

entities.name: Stick-Up Jobs
entities.description: Repeatable armed robberies confirmed: case the joint, then choose speed or profit. Cops respond.

entities.name: WAINK Car Boosts
entities.description: The WAINK app scans parked cars and shows their value. Confirmed: steal smart, not random.

entities.name: Wildlife Study
entities.description: Animals can be studied and new species tracked. Rockstar says there are over 170 species, some tracked as Rare, Discoverable or Legendary. Swamp = jackpot.

entities.name: Ryde Me Gigs
entities.description: The Ryde Me ride-hailing app is confirmed. Driving gigs for players are our speculation.

entities.name: Real Dimez Promo Runs
entities.description: Bae-Luxe and Roxy need clout. Side errands for the duo are informed speculation.

entities.name: Keys Charter Work
entities.description: Fishing and casual boating are confirmed in the Keys; charter side-work is our prediction.

entities.name: Mud Crew Errands
entities.description: Thrillbilly regulars always need parts hauled. Speculative flavor around a confirmed venue.

entities.name: Thrillbilly Mud Club
entities.description: The off-road mud park from Trailer 1: monster trucks, swamp buggies, and zero restraint.

entities.name: Gellhorn International Raceway
entities.description: Motorsport facility spotted in official material; race-car driving was shown in the Extended Look.

entities.name: Street Basketball
entities.description: Shooting hoops confirmed in the Extended Look sizzle reel.

entities.name: Gym & Weights
entities.description: Working out is confirmed, and your body actually changes with exercise, food, and sleep.

entities.name: Boxing
entities.description: Boxing appeared in the Extended Look's activity roll. Venue TBC.

entities.name: Pool Hall
entities.description: Billiards confirmed in the Extended Look. Hustle responsibly.

entities.name: Shooting Range
entities.description: Ranges confirmed in the Extended Look. Expect accuracy challenges.

entities.name: Base Jumping
entities.description: Basejumping confirmed. Downtown towers are the obvious launchpads.

entities.name: Skydiving (Airport)
entities.description: Parachuting confirmed; Leonida's big international airport west of the city is the natural hub.

entities.name: Mini Golf
entities.description: Mini golf confirmed in the Extended Look. Nine holes of pastel chaos.

entities.name: Jet Ski Rental
entities.description: Jet skiing confirmed, shown ripping along the beachfront in the Extended Look.

entities.name: Electric Scooters
entities.description: Electric scooter riding confirmed. The boardwalk will never be safe again.

entities.name: Kayaking
entities.description: Kayaking confirmed in the Extended Look. Calm water, big gators. Pick your line.

entities.name: Lake Fishing
entities.description: Fishing is confirmed both in Rockstar's Kalaga blurb and the Extended Look.

entities.name: Kalaga Hunting Grounds
entities.description: Rockstar's own Mount Kalaga description promises hunting in the national park.

entities.name: Off-Road Trails
entities.description: Off-road trails are part of Rockstar's official Kalaga pitch. Dirt bikes welcome.

entities.name: Scuba Diving
entities.description: Diving confirmed in the Extended Look, and the Keys hide the most dangerous waters in America.

entities.name: Airboat Runs
entities.description: Fanboat driving through the swamp, confirmed on camera in the Extended Look.

entities.name: Dirt Bike Track
entities.description: Dirtbiking and dirt-bike race tracks confirmed in the Extended Look.

entities.name: Zoo
entities.description: Zoos are on Game Informer's activity list, and one appeared in the Extended Look. Where it sits is still TBC, so the pin is provisional.

entities.name: Snapmatic Spot: Ocean Beach
entities.description: Snapmatic is back, officially. Pastel art-deco hotels + white sand = the obvious first shot.

entities.name: Snapmatic Spot: Keys Bridge
entities.description: The long overseas highway bridge from the trailers. Golden hour or don't bother.

entities.name: Snapmatic Spot: Allied Crystal Refinery
entities.description: Ambrosia's official landmark: the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, straight from Rockstar's blurb.

entities.name: Snapmatic Spot: VC Port
entities.description: Cruise ship capital of the world, per Rockstar. Shoot the big boats.

entities.name: Snapmatic Spot: Kalaga Overlook
entities.description: Highest ground in Leonida. Photo-spot checklists are our framing; the vista is real.

entities.name: Hidden Packages (Expected)
entities.description: Every GTA has a hidden-collectible set; none announced for VI yet. Placeholder for the city set.

entities.name: Hidden Packages: Keys (Expected)
entities.description: Series-tradition prediction for an island collectible chain. Honest guess, zero confirmation.

entities.name: American Alligator
entities.description: All over Trailer 1 and the official Grassrivers screenshots, including one in a gas station.

entities.name: American Flamingo
entities.description: A whole flamboyance opens Trailer 1. Shallow lagoons are their turf.

entities.name: Brown Pelican
entities.description: Seen cruising over the ocean in Trailer 1. Beachfront regular.

entities.name: Bottlenose Dolphin
entities.description: Spotted offshore in official footage. Boat out past the sandbar.

entities.name: Sea Turtle
entities.description: Rockstar's own Keys description promises sea turtles. Official, in writing.

entities.name: Tiger Shark
entities.description: Community-identified from trailer footage. The most dangerous waters in America, remember.

entities.name: Key Deer
entities.description: Community-spotted in footage: the tiny island deer, right where it belongs.

entities.name: West Indian Manatee
entities.description: Rockstar named manatees among Leonida's native species in September. Slow zone in the marina, please.

entities.name: Raccoon
entities.description: Caught raiding a trash can in Trailer 2. A professional.

entities.name: Dogs (Pet / Scold / Study)
entities.description: The Extended Look confirmed dog interactions: Pet, Scold, Study. We know which one you'll pick.

entities.name: Green Iguana
entities.description: Rockstar lists green iguanas among Leonida's invasive species. Sunning wherever it pleases.

entities.name: Herring Gull
entities.description: Community-identified beach menace. Guard your fries.

entities.name: Wild Boar
entities.description: One bolts across a chase sequence in Trailer 2. Farm country roamer.

entities.name: White-tailed Deer
entities.description: Hunting is official in Kalaga; whitetail as the headline species is community consensus.

entities.name: Leonida Panther
entities.description: The Florida panther's stand-in. A visitor report disputes our park placement, and real panthers keep to the southern swamps. Unverified until launch footage settles it.

entities.name: Ocean Drive Throwback
entities.description: The art-deco strip mirrors 2002's Vice City shot-for-shot in places. Callback hunting starts here.

entities.name: Leonida Man Sightings
entities.description: Trailer 1's hammer-toting rooftop rager and friends, Rockstar's love letter to real Florida headlines.

entities.name: Swamp Lights Rumor
entities.description: Every Rockstar map hides a UFO. Nothing confirmed for VI, so this pin is pure tradition.

entities.name: Lake Monster Rumor
entities.description: Community folklore, zero evidence. We keep it because mystery pins are fun and we said we'd be honest.

entities.name: Abe Gonzalez
entities.description: Wealthy lawyer who runs the Lucretia Law Group; Valentina recommends him to Jason and Lucia.

entities.name: Andrea
entities.description: Member of Raul's crew, first met in Chapter 3.

attributes.appearances: Credit Check, The Missing Link, Dirty Work

entities.name: Andrés de León
entities.description: Head of Megamundo. Hires Jason and Lucia.

entities.name: Andy
entities.description: A friend of Lucia's living in the Keys; he gives her a questline.

entities.name: Arnold
entities.description: Brian Heder's long-time broker.

entities.name: Abismo Key & Maroon Key
entities.description: Area of Mariana County on the gtadb.org map.

entities.name: Ambrosia
entities.description: Sugar country on the shores of Lake Leonida

entities.name: Balsero
entities.description: Area of Vice-Dale County (Vice City) on the gtadb.org map.

entities.name: Airgator Airboat 09
entities.description: Airgator's Airboat 09 is a boat styled after the Diamondback Hunting & Fishing Airboat. It is new to the series in GTA 6.

entities.name: Airgator Airboat Police
entities.description: A law enforcement version of the Airgator Airboat 09, painted in wildlife officer and county sheriff colours for patrols on Leonida's swamps and shallows.

entities.name: Albany Alpha
entities.description: Albany's Alpha is a sports car styled after the Cadillac Sixteen. Back from earlier GTA games, it seats two and uses rear-wheel drive.
Duke Arms' single-stack .45-style handgun based on the M1911, with an eight-round magazine. It costs $1,050 at Ammu-Nation, and Jason uses one to rob a liquor store in Trailer 1.

entities.name: Akulus
entities.description: Scorpio's heavy six-shot hunting revolver, based on the Taurus Raging Hunter, that hits far harder than most handguns. It costs $3,000 at Ammu-Nation.

attributes.how_to_get: Unique variant of the Nipper .38. Abandoned boat on the south-east island of the Permit Keys, near its southern tip.

entities.name: Assault Rifle
entities.description: A fully automatic assault rifle serving as the primary combat weapon of the GTA series, confirmed for GTA VI with customizable attachments for Leonida firefights.

attributes.seen_in: Trailer 2; gold version in the Extended Look

entities.name: Adventures in Babysitting
entities.description: Adventures in Babysitting is a Chapter 4 Jason mission: guard Andres at The Vault nightclub until FAP tries to kidnap him and his son Rafa is taken.

attributes.story_summary: Jason works nightclub security for Andrés.

entities.name: Afternoon Delight
entities.description: Afternoon Delight: rob the Delights strip club safe (code 2008) with Vicki's help. Pick Help or Don't Help for Jason. Vicki pays $10,000 next day.

attributes.story_summary: Vicki wants to rob her boss at Delights and share the take.

entities.name: Amateur Hour
entities.description: Amateur Hour is a Chapter 4 Lucia mission: help Francisco get money back from a porn director by stopping the Coochie Camper. It pays $1,000.

attributes.story_summary: Lucia helps Cisco stand up to a director.

entities.name: Ambulance Chaser
entities.description: Ambulance Chaser is a Chapter 2 mission from Lucia. You stop and burn the ambulance from the hospital escape before the police find it. It pays no cash.

attributes.story_summary: The ambulance from the hospital escape is still close by: Lucia has to get rid of it before the police find it.

entities.name: Another Life
entities.description: Another Life is a Chapter 4 story mission with a flashback to Lucia caring for Tomas. It upgrades you to BuckMe Black and unlocks the Vice City, Baby! trophy.

attributes.reward: BuckMe Black account + Vice City, baby! trophy
attributes.story_summary: Lucia looks back on her past.

entities.name: A1 Fashions
entities.description: A clothing store beside Mami's Grocery Market in a Southside strip mall.

entities.name: Akio Hotel
entities.description: A hotel on Tequesta Retreat.

entities.name: Backyard wrestling
entities.description: Unclear whether it's an activity or a mission

attributes.how: Unlocked in chapter 1 (Gone Fishing). Also how you study animals for the 100%.
Jason only: he texts in chapter 2 and opens his hunting quests in Lummox County. His 15 target decks count for the 100%.
Jason's boss, met in chapter 1 (Gone Fishing). Buys some stolen goods during chapter 1.
Seaplane smuggler met in chapter 1 (Gone Fishing). A fence for chapter 1 only.

entities.name: Australian shepherd
entities.description: Australian Shepherd is one of six confirmed dog breeds in GTA 6. Jason can pet, scold or study dogs.

tracks: Gye Wani (Pat Thomas ft. Ebo Taylor)

attributes.hosts: MW & Delta Dawne (+ Mud Dog Mike)
tracks: Need a Little Time Off for Bad Behavior (David Allan Coe)
The Conversation (Hank Williams Jr. & Waylon Jennings)
Si Es Trucho Es Trucho Remix (Axel Rulay ft. Farruko, El Alfa)
Born N Raised (DJ Khaled ft. Trick Daddy, Rick Ross, Pitbull)

entities.name: 7th Avenue Garage
entities.description: One-car garage east of Vice City International Airport, for sale at $12,000 in the Vice City Real Estate app (unlocked by Daily Driver, chapter 2).

entities.name: Atlantic Court Garage
entities.description: One-car garage in Ocean Beach, south of the Y Hotel, for sale at $40,000 in the Vice City Real Estate app (unlocked by Daily Driver, chapter 2). The most expensive of the eight.

entities.name: Bayside Safehouse
entities.description: Borrowed apartment, unlocked by the mission Welcome to Vice City (Chapter 3).

entities.name: Bonita Court Garage
entities.description: One-car garage in central Washington Island, for sale at $34,000 in the Vice City Real Estate app (unlocked by Daily Driver, chapter 2).

entities.name: Brian's Boat Works & Marina
entities.description: Brian's boat yard, where the Swamped mission starts, and a smuggling route.

entities.name: Final Chapter MC
entities.description: Outlaw biker club based around Ambrosia.

entities.name: Key Lento Police Department
entities.description: Key Lento police; one officer oversees Lucia's community service.

entities.name: Leonida Department of Corrections
entities.description: Runs Leonida Penitentiary, where Lucia served her sentence.

entities.name: "Before Race and Chase 7": Rockstar mocks the wait
entities.description: Leonida's social feed recycles the famous "we got X before GTA 6" meme: one post sells a game as coming out before Race and Chase 7, another says the game is delayed again. Race'n'Chase was the working title of the very first GTA.

attributes.how_to_find: Scroll the in-game social feed on the phone, for example when Jason goes to bed, early in the story.

entities.name: $20,000 in a warehouse with a teddy bear van
entities.description: An abandoned red warehouse east of Hamlet holds bags of cash worth about $20,000, weapons and valuables, with more loot in the chests and the vans parked around it.

attributes.how_to_find: Head east of Hamlet, near Peacock Estates, and look for a van covered in teddy bears outside a red warehouse. Search the building, open the chests and check the vans.

entities.name: A bunker under a blue RV, with a rocket launcher
entities.description: In a small trailer park in southwest Vice City, a hatch in the floor of a blue RV leads to a secret bunker stocked with a legendary SMG, a rocket launcher, grenades and ammo.

attributes.how_to_find: Find the trailer park across from an Ammu-Nation, near the Griffin Shooting Range. Enter the blue RV next to the wrecks and open the floor hatch.

entities.name: A dog on a jet ski comes to rescue you
entities.description: Lost at sea in Gambit Bay, you may see a dog pull up beside you on a jet ski. Climb on and he takes you to a hidden beach full of dogs, where a body lies with a wallet of over a thousand dollars.

attributes.how_to_find: Take a boat into Gambit Bay, west of Key Lento, jump into the water and wait. When the dog stops next to you, question him, praise him, then ride. Walk straight up from the beach to find the body. If he does not come, leave and try again.

entities.name: A memorial to Fatal Incursion
entities.description: A bronze plaque, surrounded by flowers and candles, pays tribute to Fatal Incursion, the clown-faced band from GTA Online's Los Santos Drug Wars update. Signed by the Fooligan Society of Leonida, it says the band died when their plane went down over the Leonida Strait on the way to a concert, and ends with #SADCLOWNGANG.

attributes.how: Rob an armored truck and get away. A large bank vault robbery also counts.
Reach 100% on the completion checklist, which opens after the story (Progress > Stats). Nothing on it can be missed. The longest trophy of the list.
Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It usually comes on its own as you play.
Later in the game, rob the same store a second time as Lucia, then get away on foot: driving off does not count.
Beat Cal in a fishing challenge during his questline, which opens in Chapter 1.

entities.description: Instantly gives you $250,000.

entities.name: '65 Vapid Dominator
entities.description: Spawns this vehicle next to you.

entities.name: Airboat 09
entities.description: Spawns this vehicle next to you.

entities.name: All Explosive Weapons
entities.description: Gives every explosive weapon with full ammo.

entities.name: Attack Force
entities.description: Bullets and melee hits send targets flying.

entities.name: Bleeter
entities.description: Short-post network parodying X, back from earlier games.

entities.name: Buckme
entities.description: Online bank to keep your money safe.

entities.name: Fitness
entities.description: Tracks the character's sleep and fatigue.

entities.name: RydeMe
entities.description: Books a ride to get around fast, shared trips included.

entities.name: Scooter Bros
entities.description: Delivers your personal vehicle to where you are.
